title: Loophire
summary: Full-stack AI job application agent that automates the entire application workflow. Upload your CV once — a 6-agent pipeline scores job fit (0-100 with keyword gap analysis), tailors your CV, generates a personalised cover letter, researches the company via live web search, and prepares interview questions, all in under 30 seconds with real-time WebSocket progress. Features prompt caching for ~90% cost reduction, drag-and-drop Kanban tracking, multi-CV management, LaTeX PDF export, and a Chrome extension for LinkedIn.

title: Roleprint
summary: Live NLP analytics platform tracking skill demand across 10 tech roles. Scrapes 6,000+ job postings every 6 hours from Reed, RemoteOK, and Adzuna, runs each through a 4-stage NLP pipeline (spaCy skill extraction, NLTK VADER sentiment, BERTopic topic modelling, NER), and surfaces real-time trends including week-over-week skill momentum, emerging skills, role comparisons, and a skill gap analyser.

title: Financial Pipeline
summary: Full-stack financial analysis platform. Enter any Yahoo Finance ticker — stocks, ETFs, forex, crypto, commodities — and get 8 quantitative metrics, 6 charts, and a downloadable PDF report with AI-generated descriptions. Features include asset comparison mode with Pearson correlation, scheduled email delivery with double opt-in, real-time WebSocket progress, 1-hour report caching, rate limiting, and an interactive OpenAPI dashboard.

title: Legal Temporal Reasoning Benchmark
summary: MSc research project benchmarking 6 LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, Qwen) on temporal reasoning across 300+ years of UK legislation and GDPR. Built a custom evaluation dataset with 12 task types spanning numerical, semantic, and timeline categories. Constructed an end-to-end data pipeline from UK legislation APIs, and visualised 6 research questions using Tableau.

title: Deepfake Detection Model
summary: Ternary deepfake classifier (real / deepfake / faceswap) trained on FaceForensics++ with a systematic comparison of 8 model architectures: ResNet-34, ResNet-50, ResNet-101, ResNet-152, and their SE-ResNet counterparts with squeeze-and-excitation attention. Includes data preprocessing, frame extraction pipeline, per-architecture training notebooks, and a Python GUI for real-time inference.

title: BigMart Sales Prediction
summary: End-to-end ML pipeline in R to predict product-level sales across BigMart outlets. Domain-driven hypothesis generation across store, product, customer, and macro levels. Engineered 5 new features (item category, outlet age, price per weight, MRP clusters, log transforms) and compared 5 models. Random Forest achieved the best RMSE of 1086 on validation and 1158 on the competition leaderboard.

title: Loan Eligibility Prediction
summary: Binary classification pipeline for loan approval prediction. Feature engineering grounded in financial domain knowledge: EMI, Balance Income, and Total Income features improved accuracy by 2–3%. Compared 5 models (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, and k-fold cross-validation variants). Logistic Regression selected as the final model for its superior generalisation over ensemble methods.
